gain: linear relevance grade, matching default trec_eval/pytrec_eval nDCG

bm25.zero_score: omit pages; empty result remains empty
bm25.arithmetic: precomputed float64 posting contributions, vectorized gather/add; same formula/tokenizer/order

dense.selection: English base-size endpoint, chosen before outcomes; no test selection
dense.page_score: maximum normalized dot product over all page chunks
dense.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

visual.score: fixed batch 64, global passage padding; sum max(0, passage-token dot), identical kernel shape for rerank/full
visual.image_processor: pinned default; max image tokens 768; no extra image truncation

rerank.k_selection: predeclared engineering pilot value; 10 and 100 development-only diagnostics; no main-test selection yet
rerank.empty_candidates: return empty, never silently run full visual reference

tie_break: descending score, then numeric corpus_id within pinned dataset
error_handling: fail run on missing pages/nonfinite embeddings or scores; no fabricated outcome; preserve logs and partial index
cost: resident single-query retrieval wall and process CPU time; CUDA synchronized; randomized plan order per query and repetition; model/index setup separate; energy/queue/arrival overhead unmeasured
